icon.description: Icon or logo image for the minisite.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier for the minisite. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

articles.description: Ordered references to the records included in this minisite: articles (site.mochott.article) and comic works (work.sequential.chapter, work.sequential.strip).

sortMode.description: How article listings are ordered. 'auto' sorts newest first by publish date; 'manual' uses the curator-defined order of the articles array. Defaults to 'auto'.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the minisite was created.

sourceRef.description: Branch or ref name for the source repository. Defaults to 'main'.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the minisite was last updated.

categories.description: Ordered categories that articles of this minisite can be filed under (site navigation). Independent of the platform-wide article category.

designType.description: Visual layout style for the minisite.

globalSlug.description: Globally unique slug for custom domain or top-level URL routing.

sourceType.description: Content source type for the minisite.

accentColor.description: Accent theme color as a CSS color value.

description.description: Short description of the minisite, shown in listings and metadata.

primaryColor.description: Primary theme color as a CSS color value (e.g. '#3b82f6').

backgroundColor.description: Background theme color as a CSS color value.

main.description: Record representing a minisite — a themed sub-site that groups selected articles under a custom slug and design.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique within the minisite and stable once created. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens.

category.description: A category defined by a minisite.

uri.description: AT URI of the referenced record (site.mochott.article, work.sequential.chapter or work.sequential.strip).

articleRef.description: A reference to a record included in a minisite: an article, or a comic chapter or strip.

description: A minisite record. Represents a curated collection of articles with its own branding and URL.
